title: List Pool Element
description: Pool element that composes several other pool elements together. When chosen, all listed elements are placed as a group rather than picking one. Useful for bundling related pieces that must always appear together.

fields.title: Element Type
fields.description: Must be 'minecraft:list_pool_element' for this element variant.

fields.title: Elements
fields.description: Nested array of pool element configurations to compose. Each entry follows the same shape as a normal pool element (Single, Legacy Single, Feature, or Empty). Nesting another List Pool Element is not supported.

fields.title: Projection
fields.description: How the composed group projects onto terrain.
